question.problem: An american bison has a mass of $1\,\textrm{ton}.$ What is this mass in pounds?
question.worked_solution:
A table showing the customary units of mass is given below.

| Name | Symbol | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ton | $\textrm{ton}$ | $1\,\textrm{ton} = 2,000\,\textrm{lb}$ |
| Pound | $\textrm{lb}$ | $1\,\textrm{lb} = 16\,\textrm{oz}$ |
| Ounce | $\textrm{oz}$ | $-$ |

So, $1\,\textrm{ton}$ is equivalent to $2,000\,\textrm{lb}.$
